title: CWP/20043/2025 of NIRMAL Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ.
text: IN THE PUNJAB AND HARYANA HIGH COURT AT CHANDIGARH 113 CWP-20043-2025 Date of Decision: 18.07.2025 NIRMAL ... Petitioner VERSUS STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS ... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ. Present: Mr. Y.P. Malik and Mr. Manu Sharma, Advocate for the petitioners. VINOD S. BHARDWAJ, J. (ORAL) Prayer in the present petition is for directing respondents for opening/allocating the G.P.F. Account Number of petitioner’s husband namely Ramesh Chander (since deceased) by converting the same from N.P.S. to Old Pension Scheme after taking into account the services rendered by them on temporary, daily wages and contractual basis. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that with regard to his grievance, the petitioner has already served a legal notice dated 11.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) but the respondents have not taken any action thereupon till date. He contends that the petitioner would be satisfied at this stage, in case respondent No.3- Director General, Haryana State Transport, 30 Bays Building, Sector 17, Chandigarh is directed to consider and decide the legal notice dated 11.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) served by the petitioner, by passing a speaking order in a time bound manner. authenticity of this order Notice of motion. Mr. Vivek Chauhan, Addl. A.G., Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondents and prays for some time to complete instructions and file response, if necessary. He, however, does not have any objection to the above request. Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of with the consent of the parties and without commenting anything on the merits of the case, by directing respondent No.3 to consider and decide the legal notice dated 11.05.2025 (Annexure P-10) by passing a reasoned and speaking order within a period of three months of the receipt of certified copy of this order. (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ) JULY 18, 2025. JUDGE Rajender authenticity of this order
